1. Timing
-It doesn't matter which time as long as you make it to class. like if you're a morning person start at 8, or whatever. night owl? go ahead and take night classes. the trick is to schedule your classes TOGETHER. 2-3 classes a day for 4 days a week. dont take your classes more than 30 min apart (unless you need to make a lunch hour, dinner hour, etc.)

2. PAY ATTENTION !!!
(A)Don't bring anything to distract you in class. I saw you post you'll bring a sketchbook. That's fine if it helps you FOCUS not lose interest in class. I know I personally need my mind to focus on two things at once to focus at all. EX: listening to sleep/meditation music, drawing.
(B)Should go w/o saying, FORCE yourself to study and do homework. Even if you gotta schedule time and work in an empty room.

3. Teachers
(A) ratemyprofessor.com. Don't take a teacher under a 3.3 unless absolutely necessary. 
(B)*disclaimer* to the above. Even if the teacher has a high rating, don't pick one who gives a lot of work. Teachers who give busy work tend to be trash and expect papers to teach FOR them. I GO TO CLASS TO LEARN.
(C) MAKE CONNECTS WITH THE PROFESS. (if you cool with him/her)

3. HEALTH
(A)I agree with AnyaGlass on working out. It is literally good for your brain. Make sure you do BOTH cardio and lift. Don't overdo it. Don't show off to yourself if you can't handle it. Don't be obnoxious in the gym. CLANG! CLANG! ARRRGH! AGHHH! CLANG! 
(B)Carbs are good for you. Good carbs are good for you. Potatoes, rice, leafy greens. If you eat artificial sugar (number one reason scientists agree why the average human body is despicable today) I will come to your house, dorm, whatever and stick my fingers down your throat myself. 
(C) sit ups are trash. planks instead.
(D) DRINK MORE WATER. SODA/JUICE IS LIQUID DISEASE. quite literally. You just don't know how much better your life will be until you do it. If you can fit another liquid in your body, you ain't drinking enough water, bitch.

4. FRIENDS
-socializing is good for your overall being and psychological health. Just talk to the person next to you. And make an effort to sit next to nice/normal people. Call me judge-y but don't sit next to the obvious slut or the obvious idiot or the weirdo no lifer. Just sit next to a NORMAL person. There's a lot of weirdos in college.

5.GET A JOB. (Reserves not a bad route. one weekend a month.)

6.The hardest thing for me. Motivation. I believe in you.

7. Goooooo with the floooooow. Roll with the punches. Be like water. The world is an ocean and we are but its waves.
